chapters.reason: The paper's core method is 'delayed next-token prediction' using a learnable pause token appended to the input, which directly matches the key phrase and description of a single, uniform control mechanism.

The approach allows the model to manipulate extra hidden vectors (internal states) before outputting the next token, aligning with reasoning regulation via internal states rather than explicit token sequences.

The method of processing extra computation (via pause tokens) before committing to an answer can be viewed as a form of progressive refinement of the internal reasoning process, though it is not explicitly iterative or curriculum-based.
